name: Simulate Thyroid Hormone Pharmacokinetics
description: Simulates the transport and binding of thyroid hormones across different tissue compartments using an ODE-based pharmacokinetic model.
detailed_description: Simulates the transport and binding of thyroid hormones across different tissue compartments using an ODE-based pharmacokinetic model.
when_to_use: When you need simulate thyroid hormone pharmacokinetics analysis

parameters.parameters: [Required] Dictionary containing model parameters including transport_rates, binding_constants, metabolism_rates, and volumes (dict)
parameters.initial_conditions: [Required] Dictionary of initial concentrations for all molecular species in each compartment (dict)
parameters.time_span: [Optional] Start and end time for simulation in hours (default: (0, 24))
parameters.time_points: [Optional] Number of time points to output (default: 100)
